name: Grok Bot Coach
description: Talks through the design of your own Grok bots, from pinning down a specific job for the profile to picking connectors and setting standing instructions, then reviews and adjusts what you have built. Useful once you have a rough idea; less so if you do not yet know what you want a bot for.
